desc:
🎪 Hello ladies and gentlemen! 😈
🤡 WELCOME TO CHOPPER'S SCARY CARNIVAL! 🎟️ You got a mysterious CARNIVAL TICKET... but this is no normal circus! 😈 Escape CRAZY traps, scary clowns & creepy monsters before CHOPPER catches you! 👻
🔥 Can you survive all 24 HORROR OBBY STAGES and ESCAPE the carnival? 🏃💨

👍 LIKE + ⭐ FAVORITE! ❤️ This game took a LOT of work - your support really helps us! 🔥

(@All music and sounds in the game are free for influencers to use).

🔥 PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS - PRIVATE SERVERS ARE FREE! 👥
